name: astrograph
author: Rodolfo Robles
description: Local code graph for TypeScript, JavaScript and PHP, exposed to agents over MCP.

scripts.build:all: for t in darwin-arm64 darwin-x64 linux-x64 linux-arm64; do echo "building $t" && bun build src/bin.ts --compile --target=bun-$t --outfile dist/astrograph-$t || exit 1; done
scripts.install:local: bun run build && mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && install -m 755 dist/astrograph ~/.local/bin/astrograph && ~/.local/bin/astrograph --version
